definitions.explanation: The state of being unnamed or unidentified. Used as a noun or as a modifier (匿名の) to describe something done without revealing one's name.

examples.japanese: {匿名|とくめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧。
{匿名|とくめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}いた→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: There was an anonymous tip, and the police took action.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{匿名|とくめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{無責任|むせきにん}→無責任：13474_musekinin⟧な⟦コメント→コメント：06956_komento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Because one can speak anonymously on the internet, irresponsible comments tend to increase.

notes:
Composed of {匿|とく} (conceal) + {名|めい} (name). Functions as both a noun and a no-adjective ({匿名|とくめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {匿名|とくめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: anonymously
- {匿名|とくめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧: anonymous tip/report
- {匿名|とくめい}⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧: anonymous message board
- {匿名|とくめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧: anonymous donation
- {匿名|とくめい}{性|せい}: anonymity (as a quality/property)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Anonymous posting has been a defining feature of Japanese internet culture since early bulletin board systems like 2⟦ちゃんねる→チャンネル：04469_channeru⟧. The default username {名無|ななし}しさん (lit. "Mr./Ms. No-Name") became iconic.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {匿名|とくめい}: anonymous (formal)
- ⟦{実名|じつめい}→実名：29349_jitsumei⟧: real name (opposite — ⟦{実名|じつめい}→実名：29349_jitsumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧ = to post under one's real name)
